confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season, beach-area location, and booking lead time. July is a moderately busy month in the Canaries, so hotel and hostel anchors are set at typical summer rates. Drink anchors use the local price relationship to beer, since direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker. The FX observation comes from a search summary that cites the RBA exchange-rates overview page; I did not open the RBA page or the F11 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Spanish coastal cities with similar tourism demand, such as Málaga and Alicante, adjusted for the Canary Islands: the lower IGIC sales tax (7%) and somewhat lower restaurant and hotel pricing than mainland beach resorts.
